tags.name: Tujunga Wash
tags.note: A canal is "an artificial waterway to allow boats or ships or to convey irrigation".  Tujunga Wash is neither.  It is a natural stream that has existed for centuries (see pre-L.A. maps).  Just like the L.A. River, it has been protected with concrete.
